source.title: PRACTICE SCENE - TEST INPUT - NOT NASA DATA
source.credit: Synthetic test input made by the Earth Sonata team (analysis/make_practice_scene.py)
limitations: Computer-drawn dashes for testing the math engine. It describes no real data.
Frames 3 and 4 are blank in the right-hand box on purpose, to practise missing information.

regions.name: Aligned lines circle (practice)
regions.description: Dashes that nearly share one direction. A fake legend is masked out.

regions.name: Mixed lines circle (practice)
regions.description: Dashes pointing every which way. Blank in frames 3 and 4.
